User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores student profile information, points, level, and companion pet state.

className.description: The grade or class level of the student.

avatar.description: Elected emoji or icon avatar representing the student.

pet.description: The state of the student's virtual companion pet.

content.description: Rich text or markdown content of the note.

subject.description: Academic subject category of the note.

interval.description: Current spaced repetition review interval in days.

nextReviewDate.description: Scheduled timestamp for the next review.

lastReviewedDate.description: Timestamp when this note was last reviewed.

ScheduleItem.title: Schedule Planner Item
ScheduleItem.description: An entry in the student's homework planner calendar.

ProgressEntry.title: Quiz Performance Log
ProgressEntry.description: Records student practice quiz results to track progress.

StudyDiagram.title: Study Diagram
StudyDiagram.description: An AI-generated academic diagram or illustration saved by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved diagram.

prompt.description: AI prompt used to generate this diagram.

imageUrl.description: The base64 encoded png image data url.

explanation.description: AI explanation and study points for the diagram.

subject.description: Academic subject category of the diagram.

StudyGroup.title: Study Group
StudyGroup.description: A collaborative study group created by a student.

subject.description: Subject category of the study group.

GroupQuestion.title: Group Question
GroupQuestion.description: A question posted to the group, which can receive answers/comments.

answers.description: Array of answers posted by other members.

GroupSession.title: Group Study Session
GroupSession.description: A scheduled virtual study session with RSVP capabilities.

GroupMember.title: Study Group Member
GroupMember.description: Details of a user belonging to a study group.

GroupMessage.title: Study Group Message
GroupMessage.description: A real-time text message sent inside a study group.

GroupNote.title: Group Shared Note
GroupNote.description: A collaborative group note readable and editable by all group members.

WhiteboardElement.title: Whiteboard Vector Element
WhiteboardElement.description: A vector drawing point, shape, text box, or sticky note on the live shared whiteboard.

points.description: Array of {x, y} coordinate coordinates for pen drawing stroke.

SharedNotes.title: Room Collaborative Notes
SharedNotes.description: A live-typing collaborative notepad document inside a virtual study session.

SharedTimer.title: Room Collaborative Pomodoro
SharedTimer.description: Real-time state of the session-wide joint study timer.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary user profile document containing student information.

/users/{userId}/diagrams/{diagramId}.description: User's personal saved study diagrams and illustrations.

/groups/{groupId}/members/{memberId}.description: A student who is joined in the group.

/groups/{groupId}/messages/{messageId}.description: A secure real-time message stream for the group.

/groups/{groupId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Shared notebook for brainstorming and task distribution inside study groups.

/groups/{groupId}/questions/{questionId}.description: Interactive questions and academic peer help boards within the group.

/groups/{groupId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Scheduled virtual live study sessions for group participants.

/groups/{groupId}/sessions/{sessionId}/b.description: Dynamic vector drawing/sticky notes synchronizer for collaborative whiteboards.

/groups/{groupId}/sessions/{sessionId}/s.description: Real-time collaborative text editor state for joint session notes.
Live sync of Pomodoro timer values across all virtual room participants.
